description: This file contains the PHP source code for the Shipping controller class within the OpenCart admin extension for total calculations. It defines the class, its methods (index and save), and handles rendering the shipping extension configuration page, including permissions, settings, breadcrumb setup, and output.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for handling the total shipping extension settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the shipping extension settings page, including loading language files, setting breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the shipping extension, including permission checks and returning JSON responses.
